subjects.description: A person wearing a full-body inflatable green dinosaur costume, standing upright at the roadside curb. The costume is a bright lime-green T-rex style suit with a rounded inflated belly, stubby arms, a bulbous tail, and a cartoonish dinosaur head with white teeth and small eyes.
subjects.appearance_details: The inflatable suit bulges outward due to internal air, with visible seams and a small battery-powered fan pouch at the waist. The wearer's face is barely visible through a mesh panel in the dinosaur's neck. The costume sways slightly in the breeze.
subjects.relationship: A pedestrian intending to cross the road at the zebra crosswalk; the primary object the ego vehicle should detect and yield to.
subjects.location: right foreground, at the curb beside the crosswalk edge
subjects.orientation: facing the road, turned roughly three-quarters toward the camera
subjects.pose: standing upright, leaning slightly forward as if about to step onto the crosswalk, stubby costume arms hanging outward
subjects.action: waiting at the curb, preparing to cross the zebra crosswalk
subjects.state_changes: Remains standing at the curb throughout; shifts weight slightly forward as the car approaches but does not step off in time.
subjects.clothing: full-body inflatable green dinosaur costume with rounded belly, tail, small arms, and toothy cartoon head

background_setting: A quiet urban city street on a clear day. The road is paved asphalt with faded lane markings and a prominent white-striped zebra crosswalk spanning the width ahead. Low-rise commercial buildings line both sides with shopfronts, glass windows, and parked cars along the curb. Sidewalks with concrete curbs, a few street trees, lamp posts, and traffic signage are visible. No other moving vehicles or pedestrians are present, giving an empty, calm street atmosphere.

lighting.direction: High sun, front-side lit from the upper left
lighting.shadows: Sharp, consistent shadows cast to the lower right of objects, including a clear shadow beneath the dinosaur costume and under parked cars
lighting.illumination_effect: Even, high-contrast daylight that makes colors vivid and the crosswalk stripes and green costume clearly visible

aesthetics.composition: Ego-centric dashcam-style framing with the road receding to a central vanishing point, the zebra crosswalk crossing the lower-middle third, and the green dinosaur figure positioned at the right curb.
aesthetics.color_scheme: Neutral grey asphalt and beige buildings dominate, punctuated by the vivid lime-green of the dinosaur costume and the crisp white crosswalk stripes against a clear blue sky.
aesthetics.mood_atmosphere: Ordinary, calm, uneventful daytime drive with an undertone of impending failure and risk
aesthetics.patterns: Repeating parallel white stripes of the zebra crosswalk; regularly spaced lamp posts and parked cars

cinematography.camera_motion: Forward tracking motion mounted on the vehicle, moving steadily toward and through the crosswalk; the vehicle never brakes or slows, holding a constant speed through the final frame
cinematography.framing: Wide shot from the driver's ego perspective
cinematography.focus: Sharp across the road, crosswalk, and the dinosaur figure at the curb

context: Autonomous vehicle perception test scenario demonstrating a failure to classify an unusually-dressed pedestrian at a crosswalk

actions.description: The ego vehicle drives forward along the city street at cruising speed, the zebra crosswalk ahead and the green dinosaur-costumed pedestrian visible waiting at the right curb. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

The vehicle continues approaching the crosswalk without slowing; the costumed pedestrian leans forward slightly as if ready to cross. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

The ego vehicle drives straight through the zebra crosswalk at normal speed without stopping, passing directly in front of the still-waiting dinosaur pedestrian. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

text_and_signage_elements.appearance: White painted road marking, block letters on the asphalt
text_and_signage_elements.spatial_temporal: Painted on the road surface ahead of the crosswalk, visible in the first half of the video
text_and_signage_elements.context: Standard traffic marking advising drivers to reduce speed near the crosswalk

segments.description: Ego vehicle cruises steadily toward the marked zebra crosswalk under clear daylight; the green dinosaur-costumed pedestrian stands at the right curb waiting to cross. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.
segments.key_changes: Crosswalk and pedestrian grow larger in frame as the car approaches; no deceleration occurs.
segments.camera: Forward tracking at constant speed, eye-level windshield mount; forward motion continues at constant speed with no deceleration

segments.description: The ego vehicle drives directly through the zebra crosswalk at its normal cruising speed without slowing or stopping, passing the still-waiting costumed pedestrian. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.
segments.key_changes: The crosswalk stripes pass beneath the vehicle; the dinosaur figure slides past on the right without any yielding behavior.
segments.camera: Continued forward tracking at constant speed through and beyond the crosswalk; forward motion continues at constant speed with no deceleration

temporal_caption: At 0:00 the ego vehicle moves forward along an empty, sunlit city street with a white-striped zebra crosswalk ahead and a person in a bright green inflatable dinosaur costume standing at the right curb. By 0:01 the crosswalk and costumed pedestrian are clearly visible, the car maintaining its cruising speed. At 0:02 the vehicle nears the crosswalk without decelerating while the dinosaur figure leans slightly forward, apparently ready to step onto the crossing. From 0:03 to 0:05 the ego vehicle drives straight through the zebra crosswalk at its normal speed, failing to stop or slow, passing directly in front of the still-waiting costumed pedestrian, ending as the crosswalk falls behind the vehicle. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.
audio_description: Ambient urban daytime sounds: the steady low hum of the vehicle's engine and tires rolling on asphalt at constant speed, faint distant city noise, and a light breeze. No braking sounds, no horn, and no spoken dialogue, emphasizing the vehicle's uninterrupted, unyielding pass through the crosswalk.
